name: Question 10
problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-17 & 8 & 0 & 7 \\ -7 & 4 & 5 & 5 \\ 5 & -4 & 5 & -2 \\ 6 & -2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 4 & 3 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 3 \\ -7 & 0 & 3 & 0 \\ 6 & -2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $B$ above. By applying three matrix elementary row operations 

- ${R}_{1}:=…$
- ${R}_{2}:=…$
- ${R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-2{R}_{4}$

each of the form ${R}_{i}:={R}_{i}+k{R}_{4},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the missing elementary row operations?
worked_solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make entries above ${a}_{42}=-2$ equal to $0.$

To do this, we can apply the following elementary row operations:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}-17 & 8 & 0 & 7 \\ -7 & 4 & 5 & 5 \\ 5 & -4 & 5 & -2 \\ 6 & -2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+4{R}_{4}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 4 & 3 \\ -7 & 4 & 5 & 5 \\ 5 & -4 & 5 & -2 \\ 6 & -2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+2{R}_{4}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 4 & 3 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 3 \\ 5 & -4 & 5 & -2 \\ 6 & -2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-2{R}_{4}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 4 & 3 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 3 \\ -7 & 0 & 3 & 0 \\ 6 & -2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =B\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the missing elementary row operations are

$\,$ ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+4{R}_{4}\,$ and $\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+2{R}_{4}.$

Question 10

A=[−17807−74555−45−26−21−1],B=[70435073−70306−21−1]

Consider the matrices A and B above. By applying three matrix elementary row operations

  1. R1:=…
  2. R2:=…
  3. R3:=R3−2R4
each of the form Ri:=Ri+kR4, the matrix A can be transformed into the matrix B. What are the missing elementary row operations?

a
R1:=R1−4R4 and R2:=R2−2R4
b
R1:=R1+4R4 and R2:=R2−2R4
c
R1:=R1+4R4 and R2:=R2+2R4
d
R1:=R1−4R4 and R2:=R2+2R4
e
R1:=R1+2R4 and R2:=R2+4R4
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To transform A into B, we need to make entries above a42=−2 equal to 0.

To do this, we can apply the following elementary row operations:

A=[−17807−74555−45−26−21−1]R1:=R1+4R4∼[7043−74555−45−26−21−1]R2:=R2+2R4∼[704350735−45−26−21−1]R3:=R3−2R4∼[70435073−70306−21−1]=B

Therefore, the missing elementary row operations are

R1:=R1+4R4 and R2:=R2+2R4.
